label: Premise & humor
hint: The SHAPE of what makes a scene work here (a real complication must happen on-screen, vary the kind of complication/closing beat) -- not what the premise is ABOUT, that's a creative fact, not a rule.

label: Variety & exclusions
hint: Rules against repeating species/roles/tropes/closing lines across scripts, and any specific banned cliches.

label: Tone
hint: Emotional/content boundaries -- what's in bounds and out of bounds (e.g. no real peril, no dark humor).

label: Dialogue & voice style
hint: How lines should sound and deliver -- character energy, banned generic-narration patterns, voice tagging.

label: Structure
hint: Camera/scene continuity rules (cuts, location changes, shot count).

label: Continuous action
hint: How physical motion must be depicted across beats (not just before/after snapshots) and kept in sync with dialogue timing.

label: Anatomy accuracy
hint: Rules keeping each animal's real anatomy correct through every pose.

label: Audio & speech
hint: Caps/punctuation limits, pacing math, mouth-movement/voiceover sync rules.

label: Timestamps & beat count
hint: Required beat count and timing rules.

label: fml2v prompt structure
hint: Rules for how first/middle/last delta prompts must be written.

label: Negative-prompt baseline
hint: A single comma-separated list of default negative-prompt terms.
